critical_findings: Single-point avg err is norm of mean error vector, not mean of error norms.
Precision RMS is root mean squared 3D distance from mean, denominator n.
Multi-point point pairs are dependent; all-point rigid-fit residual is not held-out TRE.
Phantom.calibrate uses similarity (scale allowed); DistMeasurement reg stats use rigid body.
Rotation default step 0.25 deg disagrees with generated HTML 1 deg statement; actual sample increments are thresholded, not guaranteed uniform.
Only PointerToTracker OK checked in relative-position sampling callback, no timestamps/freshness recorded.
Empty stats can be zero; .any() treats legal zero coordinates as false; local implementation must use explicit validity.
AnalyzePhantomJSON.m expects older JSON keys/shapes; not assumed compatible with current Python export.
